svg.title: The baseball search of tiled placement, in rounds
svg.desc: Three queries' ranked edges, coloured by tile. Each round optimises the next 8 ranked edges of every query still searching, tile by tile. pplacer's stopping rule is then replayed in rank order: query 1 stops at rank 7, so its rank 8 is discarded; query 3 stops at rank 8; query 2 needs a second round and stops at rank 12, so its ranks 13 to 16 are discarded. The kept edges are refined.
svg.text: the next 8 ranked edges of every query still searching, run tile by tile; then pplacer's rule is replayed
each tile is rebuilt once per round, for every query

text.tspan: : strike n, more than 3 below the best
